scripts.plots#

Functions

allocation_dict_to_df(n_allocation[, kinds])

Converts allocation dict:

build_allocation_lookup(n_allocation)

build_capacity_compare_from_items(n_rp, items)

Output index: MultiIndex (kind, name) Columns: label, carrier, unit, SP, WS-..., .

component_capex_long_per_scenario(n, scenarios)

Compute conditional (per-scenario) CAPEX by component name.

component_opex_long_per_scenario(n, scenarios)

Compute conditional (per-scenario) OPEX by component name for Generators and Links.

compute_lcop_by_technology(n, out_csv, out_plot)

Compute LCOP, revenue, and annual profit for each technology injecting into a product collection bus (tagged is_product_bus=True).

export_shadow_prices_mean_csv(n, bus_list, ...)

Save energy-weighted mean marginal price for each bus; returns {bus: mean} dict.

extract_deterministic_from_stochastic(n[, ...])

Slice ONE scenario out of a stochastic PyPSA network and return a "normal" deterministic-like network (no MultiIndex in component tables).

figure_heatmaps_compare_scenarios(n, items)

Adds (optional) final column: stochastic (scenario×snapshot weighted).

figure_heatmaps_compare_scenarios_actual(n, ...)

Same scenario logic as figure_heatmaps_compare_scenarios, but:

filter_bus_list_mp(n, bus_list[, link_th])

Return buses from bus_list that have at least one injecting link with capacity >= link_th.

filter_items_by_capacity_threshold(n, items)

Returns a NEW items list where each item's selector becomes an explicit allow-list of component names that exist and have installed capacity >= th.

heatmap_day_hour(series, ax[, vmin, vmax, ...])

series: hourly pd.Series with DatetimeIndex Creates a heatmap with y=hour(0..23), x=day-of-year.

heatmap_day_hour_actual(series, ax, norm[, ...])

series: hourly pd.Series with DatetimeIndex (actual values) norm: matplotlib Normalize/TwoSlopeNorm defining color scaling (capacity-based)

make_global_summary_costs(n[, ...])

make_global_summary_costs_by_agent(n, ...[, ...])

plot_capacity_compare_from_items(df[, ...])

plot_ldc_inputs_by_scenario(n[, outpath, ...])

Subplot per scenario; deterministic -> single plot.

plot_shadow_prices_mean_bar(means, out_path)

Bar chart of energy-weighted mean marginal prices by bus.

plot_total_system_cost_stacked(summary[, ...])

summary = output of make_global_summary_costs() Stacked bars: scenarios on x-axis, stacks are 'group' (carrier or mapped group).

plot_utilization_ldc_by_scenario(n, items[, ...])

items = [{"label","kind","field","selector"}, ...] Adds an optional final panel: stochastic weighted LDC (scenario_prob × snapshot weights). Requires helper functions already in the codebase: - _scenario_list_from_tcols - _available_names_from_tcols - _match_names_exact_exi - _nominal_from_component_table - _series_from_mi_cols - _ldc (simple unweighted LDC) - _weighted_ldc (weighted LDC returning xq,yq).

print_network(n, n_flags, nc_path, ...)

run_plot_and_export(*, n, c, csv_folder, ...)

Run plotting + CSV exports.

run_plot_operational(*, n, c, plot_folder, ...)

Run only the operational (dispatch) plots.

run_plot_rh_comparison(*, n_pf, n_rh, ...)

Generate side-by-side PF vs RH cost comparison plots and CSV.

save_cost_assumptions_csv(tech_costs_used, ...)

Save the technology cost assumptions used in the model as a CSV.

save_full_component_csv(n, ...[, num_tol, ...])

Save a comprehensive human-readable table of all optimal-capacity components.

save_opt_capacity_components(n_opt, ...)

Saves optimal capacities + annualized capex for allocated assets.

save_pypsa_statistics(n, file_path)

Save n.statistics() DataFrame as CSV.
